content.en: It’s the girl who was drumming! Haha, great job out there!
content.zh: 是敲鼓的小姑娘！哈哈，辛苦了啊！

content.en: (Ah, so many people are crowding around.)
You played the drums really well! It’s been a long time since I’ve seen a young person so actively participate in the festival—this makes me so happy!
content.zh: 小姑娘鼓敲的很好嘛！好久没看到这么积极参与大会的年轻人了！真让人高兴！

content.en: Where are you heading now? If you go right, that’s Jinlan Temple. The awards probably haven’t started yet, but the scenery over there is beautiful!
content.zh: 你这会儿是要去哪里玩呀？往右边走是金兰观，颁奖应该还没开始，不过那边的风景很好哦！

content.en: Hey now! Don’t scare the kid—
content.zh: 嗨呀！你们别吓着这孩子了——

content.en: (Everyone’s a bit too enthusiastic... I should slip away while I can.)
content.zh: （大家有点太热情了，我还是趁机溜走吧。）
